scope: Isolated inert production-renderer DOM and real CSS/PNG in Android Chrome; not the authenticated app WebView, real result, or physical S25.

batch.limitation: Fresh child navigation per case. Assertions cover child geometry, scroll and visible PNGs; this initial run did not assert parent iframe bounds.

fixtureCorrection.cause: At increasing iframe width, the harness read innerWidth after mutating width while the previous left offset remained. Temporary overflow expanded Android Chrome layout viewport to434/visual412 and left the harness shifted. Header constraint alone was insufficient.
fixtureCorrection.fix: Snapshot visualViewport.width before writes, reset iframe left to0 before growing width, then center against the saved visual width. Add parent viewport/scroll/bounds assertions.
fixtureCorrection.result: Parent frame and rendered card now fit the actual viewport; final4/4 includes parent bounds. No application CSS changed. This fixture defect is not claimed as cause of the earlier authenticated-app clipping.
